name: ChurnDesk
overview: AI-powered customer support and incident response platform for ticket investigation, resolution coordination, and escalation.
problem: Subscription businesses frequently discover customer dissatisfaction only after cancellation has already occurred.
solution: ChurnDesk helps teams investigate support tickets, retrieve relevant information, coordinate resolutions, and escalate issues that need human attention.
